The selected backend supplies CPU, VMM,.en: The selected backend supplies CPU, VMM, Virtualization and GPU together. Shut down the Virtual Mac, change the backend, then close and reopen the app.
The selected backend supplies CPU, VMM,.zh_CN: 后端统一切换 CPU、VMM、Virtualization 与 GPU。请先关闭虚拟机，选择后端后关闭并重新打开 App。
The selected backend supplies CPU, VMM,.zh_TW: 後端統一切換 CPU、VMM、Virtualization 與 GPU。請先關閉虛擬機，選擇後端後關閉並重新開啟 App。

macOS 27 supports shared NAT networking.en: macOS 27 supports shared NAT networking and Disabled. A saved bridge setting uses NAT with this backend.
macOS 27 supports shared NAT networking.zh_CN: macOS 27 支持 NAT 共享网络或停用网络。保存的桥接配置在此后端使用 NAT。
macOS 27 supports shared NAT networking.zh_TW: macOS 27 支援 NAT 共享網路或停用網路。已儲存的橋接設定在此後端使用 NAT。

Audio playback and OpenGL are available..en: Audio playback and OpenGL are available. Microphone input, Metal BC override and video encoding acceleration are not available with this backend yet.
Audio playback and OpenGL are available..zh_CN: 此后端已支持音频播放与 OpenGL。麦克风输入、Metal BC 覆盖和视频编码加速尚未实现。
Audio playback and OpenGL are available..zh_TW: 此後端已支援音訊播放與 OpenGL。麥克風輸入、Metal BC 覆蓋和影片編碼加速尚未實現。

macOS 27 currently uses the USB keyboard.en: macOS 27 currently uses the USB keyboard device.
macOS 27 currently uses the USB keyboard.zh_CN: macOS 27 目前使用 USB 键盘设备。
macOS 27 currently uses the USB keyboard.zh_TW: macOS 27 目前使用 USB 鍵盤裝置。

The Virtual Mac pauses when you lock iPa.en: The Virtual Mac pauses when you lock iPad in the foreground. Resume After Unlock only resumes a lock-triggered pause; manual pauses stay paused. Changes apply at the next Virtual Mac start.
The Virtual Mac pauses when you lock iPa.zh_CN: 当此 App 在前台时，锁定 iPad 会暂停虚拟机。解锁后自动恢复只恢复锁屏触发的暂停，手动暂停保持不变。设置在下次启动虚拟机时生效。
The Virtual Mac pauses when you lock iPa.zh_TW: 當此 App 在前景時，鎖定 iPad 會暫停虛擬機。解鎖後自動恢復只恢復鎖定觸發的暫停，手動暫停保持不變。設定在下次啟動虛擬機時生效。

Select the complete macOS 13 or macOS 27.en: Select the complete macOS 13 or macOS 27 backend. CPU, VMM, Virtualization and GPU switch together. Shut down the guest and reopen the app after changing it.
Select the complete macOS 13 or macOS 27.zh_CN: 选择全 macOS13 或全 macOS27 后端，统一切换 CPU、VMM、Virtualization 与 GPU。请先关闭虚拟机，更改后关闭并重开 App。
Select the complete macOS 13 or macOS 27.zh_TW: 選擇全 macOS13 或全 macOS27 後端，統一切換 CPU、VMM、Virtualization 與 GPU。請先關閉虛擬機，更改後關閉並重開 App。

Select one complete backend, including C.en: Select one complete backend, including CPU, VMM, Virtualization and GPU. Shut down the guest and reopen the app after changing the backend.
Select one complete backend, including C.zh_CN: 选择一套完整后端，包括 CPU、VMM、Virtualization 与 GPU。请先关闭虚拟机，切换后端后关闭并重开 App。
Select one complete backend, including C.zh_TW: 選擇一套完整後端，包括 CPU、VMM、Virtualization 與 GPU。請先關閉虛擬機，切換後端後關閉並重開 App。

Shared IPv4 NAT networking and Disabled.en: Shared IPv4 NAT networking and Disabled are available. A saved bridge setting uses NAT with either backend.
Shared IPv4 NAT networking and Disabled.zh_CN: 支持 IPv4 NAT 共享网络或停用网络。保存的桥接配置在两套后端均使用 NAT。
Shared IPv4 NAT networking and Disabled.zh_TW: 支援 IPv4 NAT 共享網路或停用網路。已儲存的橋接設定在兩套後端均使用 NAT。

Restore-image installation is not includ.en: Restore-image installation is not included in this beta. Existing virtual machines can be opened from the library.
Restore-image installation is not includ.zh_CN: 此测试版尚未包含恢复镜像安装功能。可以从虚拟机列表打开已有虚拟机。
Restore-image installation is not includ.zh_TW: 此測試版尚未包含還原映像安裝功能。可以從虛擬機列表開啟已有虛擬機。
